title: Offline capacity and training sweep of the NNUE-shaped survival leaf on the existing corpus
hypothesis: Training approaches/lifetime-objective/learned-leaf/train_leaf.py unchanged on runs/RUN-A51D-corpus/all.states (explored == 0 records, whole-origin split seed 0x59117000) over the 13-configuration grid in sweep.sh — hidden 32/64/128/256/512, mid 16/32/64, 10 or 20 epochs, lr 1e-3 or 3e-3, plus three training seeds at the baseline — yields a best held-out lifetime Pearson within 0.01 of the h64/m32/e10/lr3e-3 baseline (finding-08 recorded 0.8564 on the same split).

data.reuseDisclosure: Reads only the existing training corpus runs/RUN-A51D-corpus/all.states (SEEDLEASE-A52 training ranges 0xa5200000-0xa52152ff as recorded in runs/RUN-A51D-corpus/gen.sh; the same file finding-08 trained on). No seed is opened and no game is played. Held-out metrics use the corpus's own whole-origin test split, which finding-08 also reported on; they are diagnostic, never strength evidence.

metrics.primary: held-out lifetime Pearson correlation on the whole-origin test split (486,819 examples), best configuration minus baseline
secondary: held-out lifetime mean absolute error in moves
seed-to-seed spread of the baseline over three training seeds
metrics.uncertaintyMethod: seed-to-seed spread of the baseline configuration over three training seeds (0xA52A, 0xA52B, 0xA52C); no bootstrap

passCriteria: All 13 runs complete with finite metrics on the same split (summary.json lists 13 rows).
Gate verdict from summarize.py: supported-as-tested if delta <= max(0.005, 2 x seed spread); not-supported-as-tested if delta >= 0.02 and delta > 3 x spread; otherwise inconclusive.
Every reported number is copied from the trainer's own <tag>.json output; nothing is recomputed.
gate.failureAction: Record valid + fail (capacity or training length does matter offline); register a separate gameplay experiment before any strength claim; do not adopt any model.
gate.passAction: Record valid + pass (saturated); the next learned-leaf experiment must change the target or the feature space, not the width.

stopConditions: Stop on any rules, information-boundary, legality, determinism, or parity failure.
Stop at 3,600 wall-seconds; a partial grid is recorded as partial.
A failed training run is recorded with its log and the grid continues; the gate needs all 13 rows.
